key_news.headline: Amazon Reports Strong Q4 2025 Results with $200B 2026 CapEx Plan
key_news.summary: Net sales of $213.4B in Q4 (up 14% YoY) and $716.9B full-year (up 12%). AWS grew 24% to $35.6B - fastest growth in 13 quarters. Company plans $200B capital expenditure investment for 2026 focused on AI, chips, robotics, and low Earth orbit satellites.

key_news.headline: AWS Launches New Graviton5 CPUs and M8azn EC2 Instances
key_news.summary: AWS introduced Graviton5, company's most powerful CPU, alongside new Amazon EC2 M8azn instances. AWS now offers over 1,160 Amazon EC2 instance types.

key_news.headline: Amazon Deploys 32 Leo Satellites - Largest Payload Yet
key_news.summary: Arianespace successfully deployed 32 Amazon Leo satellites into orbit, the largest payload to date, bringing total constellation to over 200 satellites.

key_news.headline: Stock Analysts See Amazon as Buying Opportunity Despite Recent Decline
key_news.summary: Despite recent stock decline, analysts maintain 'Strong Buy' consensus rating with average price target of $279.59, forecasting 40.65% upside. Stock has declined due to massive CapEx plans.

key_news.headline: McKinsey and AWS Launch Amazon McKinsey Group Partnership
key_news.summary: Strategic collaboration designed to help organizations achieve enterprise-scale transformations with speed and impact.

regulatory_developments.details: FTC alleges Amazon uses 'Buy Box' algorithm to punish sellers with lower prices elsewhere. Could lead to court-ordered marketplace restructuring.

regulatory_developments.details: Growing regulatory scrutiny in Europe regarding Amazon's massive AI infrastructure investments.
